process_name: NSP Scholarship Application Process – Digital To-Be Workflow
summary_of_changes: Replaced all manual paper submissions with a unified digital portal, automated credential generation, metadata upload, and Aadhaar/bank verification. Introduced an AI‑assisted eligibility engine to match students with schemes, consolidated approvals, and removed duplicate handoffs while retaining human approval for critical financial and eligibility decisions.
